f1.texto: The tablecloths stand upright and all in the same direction: they can be counted at a glance and do not bend. Check that none sticks out over the edge of the tote.

f2.texto: Same article, equal rows and no gaps. That way the counting with the scale adds up and the tote does not shift on the conveyor.

f3.texto: When the product comes in a bag and lies loose in the tote, it gets disordered on the conveyor and the count can fail. Group it and flatten it.

f4.texto: Height, length and width of the product, minus the margin, give you the right box. If you are unsure about the size, measure: it is faster than redoing the order.

f5.texto: Scanner within reach, emergency stop free and only the current tote on the table. Nothing leaning on the conveyor or on the scale. Look at the label stuck on the railing: that is exactly what to avoid.

f6.texto: Not like this. The wad of used labels on the railing and the remains stuck on the totes damage the paint and dirty the workplace. Removed labels go in the bin.
